title: billing-cluster-1 down — transaction processor returning 503
description: The billing transaction processor started returning 503 Service Unavailable at 09:30 UTC. Engineering traced the error to billing-cluster-1 being unresponsive. All new payment transactions are failing. The issue started after the overnight maintenance window and has not self-resolved.

title: Payment gateway timeout — billing-cluster-1 fault
description: The payment gateway is timing out on all transaction submissions. Checkout flows across all storefronts are broken. SRE team identified billing-cluster-1 as the root cause — the cluster is down and not accepting connections. Revenue impact is accumulating. Needs immediate attention.

title: Billing dashboard UI freeze on report generation
description: The billing dashboard freezes when users try to generate monthly expense reports. This appears to be a frontend rendering issue unrelated to the payment processing backend — the UI hangs indefinitely after clicking 'Generate Report'. Affects billing team members using Chrome and Firefox.

title: Invoice PDF generation slow — document service latency
description: The invoice PDF generation service is taking 45-60 seconds per document, up from the normal 3-5 seconds. This is a different system from the billing cluster — it runs on the document generation microservice. Users are complaining about slow invoice downloads. Not blocking payments.
